item.title: Caja Costs Spike for Expats in Costa Rica - Costa Rica Star News
item.description: By Laura Gutierrez of Immigration Help Costa Rica CAJA sticker shock. item.description: This article is based on a personal experience. item.title: What is FOMO When Buying Property in Costa Rica? - Costa Rica Star News
item.description: What is FOMO? According to the popular website Wikipedia, Fear of missing out is the feeling of apprehension that one is either not in the know or missing out on information, experiences, or life decisions that could make one’s life better.
